capabilities: Render transcript lines as speech bubbles in Reading view
Color and size bubbles per speaker via frontmatter
Align the vault owner's messages to the right with configurable aliases
Show inline timestamps and date separators between days
Assign speakers to left or right sides for debates and roleplay
disambiguation: Not a messaging or chat app; it only renders existing transcript notes as bubbles in Reading view.
extras: The note must carry a transcript tag in frontmatter and be viewed in Reading mode for bubbles to render; README also lists the author's other plugins (Food Tracker, YouTrack Fetcher, Grazie Plugin).
problem: Obsidian renders Markdown transcript lines as plain paragraphs, making dialogue-style notes hard to read as conversations.
summary: Renders transcript notes as chat-style speech bubbles with per-speaker colors, timestamps, date separators, and frontmatter-based styling in Reading view.
